en.pit.departure.alias_alive: Alias thanks the party and leaves. The scent of honeysuckle fills the air as Dragonbait bows and follows her.
en.pit.departure.alias_dead: Dragonbait carries Alias's body toward Hillsfar.
en.zhentil.patrol_pass: A Zhentil Keep patrol notices the sigils on the party's arms and lets them pass.
en.zhentil.edge: You are at the edge of Zhentil Keep. Will you enter or continue your journey?
en.zhentil.guards_question: The guards take the party aside for questioning and record Journal Entry 32.
en.zhentil.guards_warning: A guard says the party matches the little thief's description; the commander says they will get theirs inside.
en.zhentil.inner_city: You join the teeming masses of the inner city.
en.journal.32: Journal Entry 32: Two guards and their commander compile a detailed file on the party and insist that it is strictly routine.
en.zhentil.olive_appears: A female halfling appears from a hidden niche. You enter her statement as Journal Entry 50.
en.zhentil.dark_shrine_entry: You enter the Dark Shrine through a hole in the wall made by the halfling's magical device. The walls close behind you as the device smokes and disappears.
en.zhentil.olive_explains: As Olive leads you through the dungeon, she explains about Dimswart the Sage. You record Journal Entry 51.
en.zhentil.dimswart_door: Dimswart is just beyond this door.
en.journal.50.1: Journal Entry 50 (1/2): Olive says, “Well now, aren't we a fine bunch of adventurers. My name is Olive Ruskettle, and I know a bit about those tattoos on your arms. A friend of mine had similar marks a while back. I wonder where she is...”
en.journal.50.2: Journal Entry 50 (2/2): “Listen, you must get hold of the Amulet of Lathander. A man who can help you has been captured inside the temple. His name is Dimswart the Sage, and he helped that friend I mentioned. I know a secret way into the temple. What do you say?”
en.journal.51.1: Journal Entry 51 (1/2): “The human you seek is Dimswart. He is a very good sage and a music lover, which is why we get along. Did you know I was a bard? Yes sir, my harp is right here and I could sing for you—well, perhaps now is not the time.”
en.journal.51.2: Journal Entry 51 (2/2): “Anyway, Fzoul Chembryl captured Dimswart to learn about the other bonds. I can get you to his cell, but I need your help to free him. I'll slip out my own way; I cannot let any Banite priests see me. Only someone as slippery as I am can squeeze through the route I know.”

zh-TW.pit.departure.alias_alive: 愛麗雅絲說：「我們必須在此分別了。」她感謝你們一路相助，祝眾人好運後轉身離去。空氣中瀰漫著忍冬花香；龍餌靜靜看過每一位夥伴，鞠躬致意，隨後跟上愛麗雅絲。
zh-TW.pit.departure.alias_dead: 龍餌抱起愛麗雅絲的遺體，向眾人沉默地鞠躬，隨後朝希爾斯法的方向離去。
zh-TW.zhentil.patrol_pass: 一隊散提爾堡巡邏兵攔住你們。他們注意到眾人手臂上的枷印後，隨即放行。
zh-TW.zhentil.edge: 你們來到散提爾堡城外。要進城，還是繼續旅程？
zh-TW.zhentil.guards_question: 「站住！到這裡來！我們有些問題要問你們！」衛兵把隊伍帶到一旁盤問；你們將此事記入冒險手札第 32 條。
zh-TW.zhentil.guards_warning: 離開時，你們聽見一名衛兵說：「果然和那個小賊說的一樣。」指揮官回答：「別擔心，他們進城後自然會吃到苦頭。」
zh-TW.zhentil.inner_city: 你們匯入熙來攘往的人群，進入散提爾堡內城。
zh-TW.journal.32: 手札條目 32：兩名衛兵與指揮官盤問你們。每回答一次「是」，其中一名衛兵便冷笑著記入冊中；每回答一次「否」，另一名衛兵便哼聲記在不同的簿冊。指揮官詳細抄下全隊的姓名、來歷與各項資料。每當有人追問盤查的理由，三人便一同冷笑；指揮官只說：「我們正在建立你們的檔案，這只是例行公事。」
zh-TW.zhentil.olive_appears: 一名半身人女子從隱密壁龕中現身。你們將她的話記入冒險手札第 50 條。
zh-TW.zhentil.dark_shrine_entry: 半身人帶著的魔法裝置在牆上開出洞口，你們就此穿牆進入幽暗神殿。身後牆壁重新閉合；裝置冒出白煙，隨即消失無蹤。
zh-TW.zhentil.olive_explains: 奧莉芙領著你們穿過地牢，一路說明賢者迪姆斯沃特的遭遇。你們將此事記入冒險手札第 51 條。
zh-TW.zhentil.dimswart_door: 迪姆斯沃特就在這扇門的另一頭。
zh-TW.zhentil.olive_leaves: 奧莉芙微微一笑，轉眼便消失了。
zh-TW.journal.50.1: 手札條目 50（1/2）：奧莉芙說：「唷，這可真是一群了不起的冒險者。我叫奧莉芙・魯斯克特爾；你們手臂上的刺青，我倒知道一點。前陣子我有個朋友也帶著相似的印記。不曉得她如今人在何方……」
zh-TW.journal.50.2: 手札條目 50（2/2）：「聽著，你們一定得拿到洛山達護符。有個人能幫忙，可是他被抓進神殿囚禁了。他叫賢者迪姆斯沃特，也曾幫過我剛才提到的那位朋友。我知道一條進神殿的密道。你們意下如何？」
zh-TW.journal.51.1: 手札條目 51（1/2）：「你們要找的人類名叫迪姆斯沃特。他是位非常出色的賢者，而且熱愛音樂，所以我們才這麼投緣。你們知道我是吟遊詩人嗎？真的，我的豎琴就在身邊，本來還能唱一曲給你們聽——唔，現在或許不是時候。」
zh-TW.journal.51.2: 手札條目 51（2/2）：「總之，弗佐爾・錢布瑞爾抓走迪姆斯沃特，是為了逼問其他枷印的事。我能帶你們到牢房，但救他出來得靠你們。我會用自己的辦法溜走，絕不能讓貝恩祭司看見我。那條路狹窄得很，只有像我這般滑溜的人才鑽得過去。」
